answer: Physical Presence Ledger. Each agent identity must periodically solve a hardware-timed challenge on a registered device whose clock drift and sensor noise are measured; the device reports a ledge-level vibration signature and ambient readings matched against its enrollment profile. A dune test field of cheap cloned devices fails because drift fingerprints diverge. Enrollment requires a ferrous token physically embedded in the operator's machine, unclonable at scale; each extra identity demands new hardware plus calibration time, capping forgery economically.
